datasets.name: UAV-derived orthomosaic imagery
datasets.verbatim: using uav-based photogrammetric capture, the locations of sinkholes and landslides could be accurately determined ... iz university final pixel size was 5.0 cm/

datasets.name: Dam slope layer
datasets.verbatim: During the data preparation phase, a dam slope layer was integrated into the images.

methods.name: Deep learning segmentation algorithms (DeepLab-v3+, Link-Net, MA-Net, PSP-Net, ResU-Net, and SQ-Net)
methods.summary: The authors evaluated six deep learning segmentation architectures (DeepLab-v3+, Link-Net, MA-Net, PSP-Net, ResU-Net, and SQ-Net) using the ResNet50 backbone to perform pixel-level classification of landslides and sinkholes from UAV imagery and slope data.
methods.verbatim: For this study, the leveraged DL models were derived from the "Segmentation models Pytorch" library (https://github.com/qubvel/segmentation_models.pytorch).

availability.author_statement: Data will be made available on reasonable request to corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are not referenced or linked, the authors' UAV imagery is restricted. The code for the deep learning classifiers is not given.
